title: AiCallRequest
description: One model call, as @cello-kit/ai's call() and json() take it, and as a later gateway's POST /v1/calls would. Prompts stay in each app; this carries them only for the call and nothing stores them.

feature.description: What the call is for (letter.draft, meetings.analyze). Usage, caps and the AI-off gate are keyed on it.

model.description: A model id; the app's default when absent.

stable.description: Text that is the same across calls (a rubric, a person's resume), sent before the files and the input so the provider's prompt cache can reuse it. From AD Hub's AiRequest.stable.

schema.description: A JSON Schema the answer must match (json() mode). A mismatch is retried once, then fails as badShape.

stream.description: Answer as NDJSON stream events instead of one JSON body.

cacheKey.description: A hash for the provider's prompt cache. Never contains the prompt itself.

timeoutMs.description: How long one provider round may take (default 180000). A tool round or a fallback starts a new one.

user.description: An opaque ref for who the call is for (a person, or a bot in AD Hub), never an email. Per-user caps and the default cache key use it; absent means the app itself.

maxOutputTokens.description: A cap on the answer's tokens (AD Hub's 1-token connection test).
